Raue Gänsedistel ( Sonchus asper ) im Hockenheimer Rheinbogen
Nom français : laiteron rude. Nom anglais : prickly sow-thistle. Tige écrasée et latex de laiteron rude.
Sonchus asper Località: Farra, Mel(BL), 330 m s.l.m.
Prickly Sow-thistle ( Sonchus asper ) in Martin's garden. 14 June 2012, in the morning sunshine! Didn't think this had come out that well when I took it, as the camera was having trouble focussing.
Laiteron rude en bord de Ravel, le long de la Sambre, Belgique.
